notes.title: Version 0.4
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Feature: Pots as Accessories[/b][/h2]
Give your plants even more personality! Choose from a variety of new pots and design your green oasis to your liking.

[h2][b]Milestone reached![/b][/h2]
An incredible [b]10,923[/b] installations – only our community can achieve that! Thank you for your support. Let's continue to fight together for a green planet!
